name: Day 01 Solution: What is Automation?
description: Reference artifact for Day 1's automation-opportunity survey, modeled as n8n data instead of a text doc.

parameters.content:
## Day 01 Solution: What is Automation?

This is a planning day with no n8n build required by the lesson, so this workflow captures Day 1's concrete artifacts (opportunities list, goals, industry application) as structured data instead of a paper doc, so you can see the same content modeled as automation-ready JSON.

Credentials needed: None needed to test the logic.

See DAILY_TASKS/DAY_01_Automation_Basics.md for the full lesson.

assignments.name: opportunities
assignments.value:
={{ [
  { current_process: 'Manually copying leads from a form into a spreadsheet', proposed_automation: 'Webhook trigger -> Set node -> Google Sheets append', impact: 'Saves ~30 min/day, removes copy-paste errors' },
  { current_process: 'Manually replying to the same 5 support questions', proposed_automation: 'Trigger on new ticket -> IF match FAQ -> auto-reply', impact: 'Faster response time, frees up support hours' },
  { current_process: 'Manually posting the same content to 3 social platforms', proposed_automation: 'One trigger fans out to 3 API calls', impact: 'Saves ~20 min/post' },
  { current_process: 'Manually checking inventory levels each morning', proposed_automation: 'Scheduled trigger checks stock API, alerts if low', impact: 'Prevents stockouts' },
  { current_process: 'Manually sending invoice reminders', proposed_automation: 'Scheduled trigger -> check due dates -> send email', impact: 'Improves cash flow, saves admin time' },
  { current_process: 'Manually compiling a weekly report from 3 tools', proposed_automation: 'Scheduled trigger pulls from each API, merges, emails PDF', impact: 'Saves ~2 hrs/week' },
  { current_process: 'Manually onboarding new clients with the same email sequence', proposed_automation: 'New-client webhook -> timed email sequence', impact: 'Consistent onboarding, saves time' },
  { current_process: 'Manually tagging expenses by category', proposed_automation: 'New-expense trigger -> rules-based category Set node', impact: 'Cleaner books, less manual entry' },
  { current_process: 'Manually backing up important files weekly', proposed_automation: 'Scheduled trigger copies files to backup storage', impact: 'Reduces risk of data loss' },
  { current_process: 'Manually notifying the team when a deploy finishes', proposed_automation: 'CI webhook -> Slack notification', impact: 'Keeps team in sync without manual pings' }
] }}
